sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Adesh Kumar,Ekansh Varma,Komal Prasad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Second supplementary affidavit filed in the Court today, is taken on record.
2.  Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

3. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 97 of 2023,
under Sections-323, 304, 427 IPC, police station Madhogarh, District Jalaun, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
As per prosecution version, a collision has taken place between Bus No. MP 30P-1127 and truck (dumper) and in that accident, five persons died of injuries.
Learned counsel submitted that applicant is driver of the truck (dumper) and it was purely a case of road accident.
The first information report was lodged under Sections 279, 337, 338, 304A, 427 IPC.
In the alleged road accident there has been no negligence on the part of the applicant and in fact it was the bus driver, who was found drunk.
During investigation, Sections 323, 304 IPC have been added without any credible evidence against the applicant.

The legal heirs of deceased persons have Jeetendra Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48220313/
1 already filed claim petitions under Motor Vehicle Act claiming compensation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further, applicant is in jail Since 8.5.2023 and no charge has been framed against the applicant so far and thus, trial of the applicant is yet to commence.

It was submitted that the applicant has no criminal history and in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
5.
Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that during investigation Section 304 IPC was added.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Jeetendra Sharma involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfactionof court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 13.5.2024 / HR  Jeetendra Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48220313/
